ambient_events: The Screaming Lot rises to a crescendo of voices that are only ever the wind, you are almost sure.
For one moment the screaming stops dead, which is far, far worse, and then it starts again.
description: A lot where a trick of the ruined structures turns the wind into a sound exactly like a great many people screaming, all the time, forever. Newcomers run toward it to help. There is no one to help. There is only the lot, and the wind, and what the sound draws in.
name: The Screaming Lot
